name: Anirudh Satsangi
abstract_title: Is It Modified Intelligence Or Artificial Intelligence As A Co-Teacher?
abstract: In recent years, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become deeply embedded in educational discourse and practice. AI-DRIVEN systems now support tutoring, assessment, content creation, and adaptive learning processes (Holmes, Bialik, & Fadel, 2021). Frequently described as a "co-teacher", AI is positioned as a collaborative partner that enhances instructional personalization and expands educational access.
